Q4. Three iconic photographs of events from the Vietnam War are connected (tenuously) to March 29.
(a) On this day in 1968, only a single soldier was convicted for an incident X which occurred a few days ago. Photos of X by a military photographer was published in the December 5, 1969 issue of LIFE Magazine and were later used in an iconic anti-Vietnam War poster.
(b) A Vietnamese-American photographer, known professionally as Nick Ut, was born on March 29, 1951. He won both the 1973 Pulitzer Prize for Spot News Photography and the 1973 World Press Photo of the Year for a 1972 photograph colloquially known as Y.
(c) An iconic photograph taken on this day, of evacuees entering an Air America helicopter on the roof of the apartment building, is often used to refer to an event Z which actually happened on April 30, 1975.
